BJP Leader Burns Cockroach Effigy; AAP Files Complaint

A Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) leader burned an effigy described as a cockroach during a Dussehra event in Delhi. The Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) has filed a complaint regarding the incident. K. Annamalai, a BJP leader, questioned whether the opposition was opposing the Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP) or providing it with free publicity in relation to the effigy burning.
